items.title: BitlockMove Tool Enables Lateral Movement via Bitlocker DCOM & COM Hijacking
items.description: A new proof-of-concept (PoC) tool named BitlockMove demonstrates a novel lateral movement technique that leverages BitLocker’s Distributed Component Object Model (DCOM) interfaces and COM hijacking. Released by security researcher Fabian Mosch of r-tec Cyber Security, the tool enables attackers to execute code on remote systems within the session of an already logged-on user, bypassing the […]…
